Original mod notes (1.1):
Guns from Classic Fallout in Rimworld.
You get the most iconic guns from Fallout 1 and 2:
- 10mm Pistol - 10mm SMG - 14mm Pistol - Hunting Rifle - Sniper Rifle
The weapons are well balanced with the base game. Let me know if you disagree and if there are any other Fallout weapons you'd like to see added.
